dimensions.rationale: Headings, KPI values, chart labels, supporting text, and modal content maintain a clear reading order at both viewports. The revised drilldown subtitle is now visibly distinct from its background without competing with the modal title.

The dashboard balances dense operational reporting with sufficient grouping and spacing. Compact captures remain readable without clipping or unusable compression. The approved dedicated AI surface is intentionally quieter than the other sections and does not prevent task completion.

Section tabs, date-range controls, refresh/export actions, PDF selections, and modal close controls have recognizable affordances and understandable labels. Range-dirty captures clearly distinguish pending input from the applied reporting range.

Selected sections, dirty date-range state, AI fallback content, PDF choices, and drilldown context are visually and semantically distinguishable. The drilldown title, revised subtitle, selected slice, totals, and peak-hour metadata communicate what data is being inspected.

All 18 recaptured states preserve coherent alignment, section structure, chart bounds, and responsive behavior. Both modal sizes remain contained within the viewport, expose one intended scroll owner, and keep their primary actions and close controls available.

The final source-bound evidence reports 76 of 76 semantic text and chart contrast samples passing. The revised drilldown subtitle measures 6.38:1 and is visibly legible in both captures. Structured modal evidence also confirms accessible naming, background isolation, initial focus placement, contained tab navigation, Escape dismissal, and focus restoration at both viewports.

The dark operational dashboard, restrained orange emphasis, compact analytics cards, chart styling, and modal treatment consistently express the established FitTrack administrative visual language across full and compact captures.

findings.observation: The explicitly approved dedicated AI reading surface retains a comparatively large quiet region between its narrative and recommendation content.
findings.user_impact: This may create modest additional eye travel for some users, but no control, status, recommendation, or task path is obscured.
findings.repair_direction: No mandatory repair. Consider modest vertical tightening only if future usability feedback shows the focused reading layout feels unnecessarily sparse.
findings.verification: If adjusted later, recapture the dedicated AI state at both viewports and confirm that narrative readability and action separation remain intact.
